H_V28_MOND_SANITY_GATE.statement: MOND residual sanity audit over 175 SPARC galaxies. Gate 1 (scale): 64 flagged. Gate 2 (floor): 0 flagged. Gate 3 (dwarf explode): 51 flagged. Total flagged: 73/175 (41.7%). Clean rows: 102. ρ(log_MBH, BCM_vs_MOND_frac) raw=-0.6461, clean=-0.4215. ρ(log_MBH, BCM_vs_Newton_frac)=-0.3399. Decisive (ρ_clean negative): True. Newton inversion confirmed (HIGH<MID): True (44.7%<82.1%>78.0%). Verdict: MOND_DEGRADED_USABLE. coherence_score=1.0000, overlap_fraction=0.4215.

context.paper_c_decision: If MOND_CLEAN_USABLE or MOND_DEGRADED_USABLE: cite cleaned MOND result. If NEWTON_ONLY: cite Newton split (HIGH<MID>LOW beats Newton). If MOND_IMPL_BROKEN: investigate MOND implementation before proceeding. Check a0=1.2e-10 m/s^2, interpolating function (simple vs standard), and fitting procedure against Lelli et al. 2017 published SPARC residuals.
context.next_step: If NEWTON_ONLY: proceed directly to Paper C using Newton split. If MOND usable: Test 30 (clean MOND split) then Paper C figures.
